name: MLI-84M Jderul
armament: 25 mm Oerlikon KBA in OWS-25R overhead turret
protection: Light armour. Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: BMP-1 style sharp ribbed nose but hull about 0.6 m longer, wider and taller than a BMP-1 (check road-wheel count against photos)
Small low-profile overhead 25 mm turret with ATGM launchers on its sides
DShK on a rotating hatch mount at the rear left of the troop compartment
Rear twin doors like the BMP-1
